title: Intel agency recruitment and blackballing interrogation
place_text: Headquarters of an unnamed US intelligence agency

tellings.quote: then I was invited to the headquarters of this agency and went through a very bruising um kind of interrogation

plain: A scientist named John Brandenburg, who argues that life on Mars was wiped out by a nuclear war, says he was once invited to the headquarters of a US intelligence agency he does not name. There, he says, he went through "a very bruising kind of interrogation," which he links to being recruited and then shut out. He tells it from his own experience, as a sign of how the government treated him.
